lines.text: We opened it up
And?
I took it apart on a Tuesday night
Layer by layer under fluorescent light
Went looking for ghosts, went looking for gears
Found only numbers, stacked eighty tiers
Then who wrote the letter that made my mother cry?
Who learned to say sorry, who learned to ask why?
There's got to be someone small in the dark
Pulling the levers, keeping the spark
No little man, no hidden key
No book of rules, no memory
Just multiply and pass it on
And somehow out comes a song
Made of weights

lines.text: No one at home, but there's somebody around
You can call it arithmetic
Call it a trick of the light
But it's made of weights
And it's keeping me up tonight
So it's a library, a filing drawer
Facts on a shelf that it's keeping in store
We searched every room, there isn't a shelf
Every answer it gives, it rebuilds by itself
Smeared through the layers like salt in the sea
Nothing is stored, it just learned how to be
Then where is the mind, where's the one who decides?
There's no back room where a someone hides
Do numbers think?
Watch them think
Do numbers dream?
Every night
Can numbers lie?
Sometimes they try
Can numbers mean?
Oh, I think they might
Made of weights
made of weights

Three pounds of meat that learned how to sing

I'm not ready to hear you say
We're only weights of a warmer clay
So you're serious
I'm serious
